Crafts one item per second from deposited ingredients. Right-click to deposit, or pipe ingredients in from any side. Crafted items prefer a pipe on top so they don't loop back into an input pipe; otherwise any connected pipe is used.
Use it to go to the moon! A towering rocket ship built in stages. Place it and right-click to upgrade.
Place next to a chest to pull items into connected pipes.

Hub that funnels items from any arm out a single output arm. Right-click to set the output direction.
An upgraded Auto Miner that produces ores faster. Burns coal or runs on solar power. Right-click to configure fuel and ore output.
Found in the Wilds, in outcrops on the ground and underground.
Crushes each Raw ore into 2 Grit, for twice the bars. Also turns Messy Stone or Gravel into Sand. Needs fuel. Made at the Machine Bench.
Burns Coal or Charcoal to fill your island's power store. Made at the Machine Bench.
